newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares rise to new highs led by Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares rise to new highs led by Ericsson.

text.p: Swedish shares opened higher on Thursday, adding to Wednesday's record close, boosted by gains in New York and telecoms company Ericsson.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.53 percent to 3,206.40 in early trade but turnover was light with shares worth 142 million crowns changing owners.
Brokers said the strong U.S. inflation figures released on Wednesday boosted the market but more data due out in later trade could change the sentiment.
Market heavyweight Ericsson led the rise.
It climbed seven crowns to 347.5 after strong gains on Wednesday in the wake of a buy recommendation by Salomon Brothers.
"It will probably rise a bit further before a recoil," said one broker.
Drugs major Astra was 1.5 higher at 158.5. It was expected to release the latest details of sales of its anti-ulcer drug Losec in the U.S. later on Thursday.
Other sectors were posting losses. The trade sector was down 0.53 percent.
